description: Returns the full publishing rules for one platform or all of them: caption and title limits and units, media counts, sizes, formats, whether media is required, hashtags, mentions, native scheduling, plus the global file rules. Use this before drafting to answer "will this fit on X / Instagram / TikTok". Returns platforms[] (one object per platform, with effectiveBodyLimit) and global. imageFormats is what the post may carry: a PNG or WebP is converted to JPEG for a platform that only takes JPEG, and a still image over maxImageBytes is compressed under it when it publishes, so neither blocks. Does NOT look at a specific account; list_accounts carries the per-account effective limits.

platform.description: Platform id such as "x", "linkedin", "tiktok". Omit for every platform.

name: get_platform_limits
title: Get platform limits
